Al contrario, se il CIBO dovesse essere inferiore al 100%, il morale scenderà.

text: View HELP instructions for VOCALOID lyric and dialogue editing.
The following two methods are available to input lyrics

rec: and dialogue for pronunciation.
1. Input by English word
If English words are input with a space between each
word, the conversion server will interpret each word into
its appropriate pronunciation. Following interpretation,
one syllable will be assigned to one sound.
Also, if a word is separated using a hyphen(s) then the
portions of the word separated by the hyphen(s) will be
interpreted as a single syllable and a single sound will
be assigned to each. Note: There may be problems
automatically interpreting words that are not in common
use. For non-English words and words that cannot be
interpreted, try the phoneme input described below.
2. Input by phoneme
You can directly assign sounds that you want pronounced
by inputting with VOCALOID's phoneme symbols.
Phoneme symbols are expressed by bracketed ([ ])
vowels and consonants which represent one syllable.
In each set of brackets ([ ]) one vowel must always be
present. Also each phoneme symbol must be separated
by a space. Any part that contains an unpronounceable
phoneme symbol will result in no sound.
When inputting lyrics, if the number of syllables for the
lyrics created does not match the number of sounds in
each bar of the composition, sounds will not be assigned
as set in the description.

Les deux méthodes de saisie suivantes sont disponibles

rec: pour la prononciation des chansons et des dialogues.
1. Saisie par mot anglais
Si les mots en anglais sont saisis avec un espace entre
chaque mot, le serveur de conversion interprétera chaque
mot avec la prononciation adéquate. Suivant
l'interprétation, une syllabe sera attribuée à un son.
Si un mot est séparé par un trait d'union, les parties du
mot séparé par le trait d'union seront interprétées comme
une seule syllabe et un seul son sera attribué à chacune
d'elle. Remarque : des problèmes peuvent survenir lors
de l'interprétation automatique de mots d'usage peu
courant. Pour les mots non anglais et les mots ne pouvant
pas être interprétés, merci d'essayer la saisie par
phonème décrite ci-dessous.
2. Saisie par phonème
Tu peux assigner directement les sons que tu souhaites
prononcer à la saisie de symboles phonèmes du
VOCALOID. Les symboles phonèmes sont exprimés par
des voyelles et des consonnes entre parenthèses ([ ]) et
représentent une syllabe.
Dans chaque groupe de
parenthèses ([ ]), une voyelle doit toujours être présente.
Chaque symbole phonème doit aussi être séparé par un
espace. Toutes parties contenant un phonème
imprononçable entraîneront un silence.
Lors de la saisie de chansons, si le nombre de syllabes
composant les chansons ne correspond pas au nombre
de sons de chaque mesure de la composition, les sons
ne seront pas assignés comme prévu dans la description.

text: HILFE für die Bearbeitung von VOCALOID-Texten und Dialogen anzeigen.
Es stehen zwei Methoden zur Eingabe von Texten und

rec: Dialogen für die Aussprache zur Verfügung.
1. Eingabe des englischen Wortes
Bei der Eingabe englischer Wörter mit Leerschritten
nach jedem Wort analysiert der Umwandlungs-Server
die Wörter nach Aussprache. Dann wird jeder Silbe ein
Laut zugewiesen.
Wird ein Wort mit Bindestrich(en) unterteilt, werden die
mit Bindestrich abgetrennten Teile des Wortes als
einzelne Silben interpretiert und jeder wird ein Laut
zugewiesen. Hinweis: Bei der automatischen Analyse
von seltener verwendeten Wörtern können Probleme
auftreten. Versuchen Sie es bei nicht-englischen
Wörtern und Wörtern, die nicht analysiert werden
können, mit der unten beschriebenen Phonem-Eingabe.
2. Eingabe nach Phonem
Sie können die Laute, die Sie ausgesprochen haben
möchten, direkt zuweisen, indem Sie sie mit den
VOCALOID-Phonemsymbolen eingeben. Phonemsymbole
werden durch Vokale und Konsonanten in Klammern ([ ])
eingegeben, die für eine Silbe stehen.
Jede Klammereinheit ([ ]) muss immer einen Vokal
enthalten. Außerdem muss jedes Phonemsymbol durch
einen Leerschritt getrennt werden. Bei Einheiten, die
unaussprechliche Phonemsymbole enthalten, werden
keine Laute ausgegeben.
Wenn bei der Eingabe von Texten die Anzahl der
Textsilben nicht der Anzahl der Laute pro Takt
entspricht, werden die Laute nicht so zugewiesen, wie
sie bei der Beschreibung eingegeben wurden.

text: Consulta le istruzioni di AIUTO per la modifica del testo e i dialoghi VOCALOID.

Per inserire testo e dialoghi per la pronuncia sono

rec: disponibili i seguenti due metodi.
1. Inserimento tramite parola in inglese
Inserendo le parole in inglese con uno spazio tra loro,
il server di conversione interpreterà ogni parola con
la pronuncia corretta. Dopo l'interpretazione, una
sillaba sarà assegnata a un suono.
Inoltre, se una parola è separata da uno o più trattini,
le porzioni della parola separate da uno o più trattini
saranno interpretate come una sola sillaba a cui
sarà assegnata un solo suono. Nota: Potrebbero
verificarsi dei problemi nell'interpretazione automatica
di parole insolite o poco usate. In caso di parole non
in inglese o non interpretabili, si consiglia di provare
a usare l'inserimento fonetico descritto qui di seguito.
2. Inserimento tramite fonema
Puoi assegnare direttamente dei suoni che vuoi far
pronunciare inserendoli con i simboli fonetici
VOCALOID. I simboli fonetici sono espressi da vocali
e consonanti tra parentesi quadre ([ ]) che
rappresentano una sillaba.
In ogni set di parentesi ([ ]) deve essere sempre
presente una vocale. Inoltre ogni simbolo fonetico
deve essere separato da uno spazio. Ogni parte che
contiene un simbolo fonetico non pronunciabile
risulterà priva di alcun suono.
Inserendo il testo, se il numero di sillabe create per il
testo non corrisponde al numero di suoni in ogni barra
della composizione, i suoni non saranno assegnati
come indicato nella descrizione.

Puedes utilizar los siguientes métodos para introducir la

rec: pronunciación de letras y diálogos.
1. Escritura por palabra inglesa
Si escribes palabras inglesas separadas por un espacio,
el servidor de conversión interpretará la pronunciación
correcta de cada una. Según esa interpretación, se
asignará un sonido a cada sílaba.
Además, si separaras con guiones fragmentos de una
palabra, cada uno de ellos se interpretará como una
sílaba y se le asignará un sonido diferente. Nota: puede
haber dificultades para interpretar automáticamente
palabras poco comunes. Si utilizas palabras en idiomas
diferentes al inglés o palabras de difícil interpretación,
usa el sistema de escritura por fonemas.
2. Escritura por fonemas
Puedes asignar directamente los sonidos que quieres oír
utilizando los símbolos fonéticos de VOCALOID. Los
símbolos fonéticos se expresan con vocales y
consonantes entre corchetes ([ ]) que representan una
sílaba.
En cada par de corchetes ([ ]) debe haber siempre una
vocal. Además, los símbolos fonéticos deben estar
separados por espacios. Si hay un fonema no
pronunciable, no se emitirá ningún sonido.
Al escribir la letra de una canción, si el número de
sílabas no se corresponde con el número de sonidos de
la composición, no se asignará ningún sonido.

text: Ver instrucciones de edición de VOCALOID.
El editor VOCALOID te permite crear canciones y datos

rec: de voz para usarlos en el juego. Para usar los datos
creados, debes convertirlos usando el servicio
NetVOCALOID.
Para convertir los datos, selecciona Red en el menú
Extras, conéctate a internet e inicia sesión en
PlayStation<I=REG>Network.  Puedes obtener una cuenta de
PlayStation<I=REG>Network desde la XMB<I=TM> (XrossMediaBar).
Cuando te hayas conectado, selecciona Solicitar
conversión de datos en el menú NetVOCALOID para
transmitir los datos al servidor de conversión de voz.
Después de realizar la solicitud, selecciona Descargar
datos convertidos para guardar los datos en un
Memory<I=BL>Stick<I=TM>. Puedes reproducir los datos
descargados en el WALKMAN del juego o usarlos para
reemplazar ciertas voces desde diferentes menús.
Las canciones y datos de voz que descargues se
reproducirán solo en tu sistema PSP<I=TM>. No podrán
reproducirse desde los sistemas PSP<I=TM> de otros
jugadores durante las CO-OPS.

text: View HELP instructions for VOCALOID lyric and dialogue editing.
The following two methods are available to input lyrics

rec: and dialogue for pronunciation.
1. Input by English word
If English words are input with a space between each
word, the conversion server will interpret each word into
its appropriate pronunciation. Following interpretation,
one syllable will be assigned to one sound.
Also, if a word is separated using a hyphen(s) then the
portions of the word separated by the hyphen(s) will be
interpreted as a single syllable and a single sound will
be assigned to each. Note: There may be problems
automatically interpreting words that are not in common
use. For non-English words and words that cannot be
interpreted, try the phoneme input described below.
2. Input by phoneme
You can directly assign sounds that you want pronounced
by inputting with VOCALOID's phoneme symbols.
Phoneme symbols are expressed by bracketed ([ ])
vowels and consonants which represent one syllable.
In each set of brackets ([ ]) one vowel must always be
present. Also each phoneme symbol must be separated
by a space. Any part that contains an unpronounceable
phoneme symbol will result in no sound.
When inputting lyrics, if the number of syllables for the
lyrics created does not match the number of sounds in
each bar of the composition, sounds will not be assigned
as set in the description.

text: Consulter les instructions AIDE pour modifier des paroles et dialogues du VOCALOID.
Éditer avec la saisie alphabet standard.
Les deux méthodes de saisie suivantes sont disponibles

rec: pour la prononciation des chansons et des dialogues.
1. Saisie par mot anglais
Si les mots en anglais sont saisis avec un espace entre
chaque mot, le serveur de conversion interprétera chaque
mot avec la prononciation adéquate. Suivant
l'interprétation, une syllabe sera attribuée à un son.
Si un mot est séparé par un trait d'union, les parties du
mot séparé par le trait d'union seront interprétées comme
une seule syllabe et un seul son sera attribué à chacune
d'elle. Remarque : des problèmes peuvent survenir lors
de l'interprétation automatique de mots d'usage peu
courant. Pour les mots non anglais et les mots ne pouvant
pas être interprétés, merci d'essayer la saisie par
phonème décrite ci-dessous.
2. Saisie par phonème
Tu peux assigner directement les sons que tu souhaites
prononcer à la saisie de symboles phonèmes du
VOCALOID. Les symboles phonèmes sont exprimés par
des voyelles et des consonnes entre parenthèses ([ ]) et
représentent une syllabe.
Dans chaque groupe de
parenthèses ([ ]), une voyelle doit toujours être présente.
Chaque symbole phonème doit aussi être séparé par un
espace. Toutes parties contenant un phonème
imprononçable entraîneront un silence.
Lors de la saisie de chansons, si le nombre de syllabes
composant les chansons ne correspond pas au nombre
de sons de chaque mesure de la composition, les sons
ne seront pas assignés comme prévu dans la description.

text: HILFE für die Bearbeitung von VOCALOID-Texten und Dialogen anzeigen.
Es stehen zwei Methoden zur Eingabe von Texten und

rec: Dialogen für die Aussprache zur Verfügung.
1. Eingabe des englischen Wortes
Bei der Eingabe englischer Wörter mit Leerschritten
nach jedem Wort analysiert der Umwandlungs-Server
die Wörter nach Aussprache. Dann wird jeder Silbe ein
Laut zugewiesen.
Wird ein Wort mit Bindestrich(en) unterteilt, werden die
mit Bindestrich abgetrennten Teile des Wortes als
einzelne Silben interpretiert und jeder wird ein Laut
zugewiesen. Hinweis: Bei der automatischen Analyse
von seltener verwendeten Wörtern können Probleme
auftreten. Versuchen Sie es bei nicht-englischen
Wörtern und Wörtern, die nicht analysiert werden
können, mit der unten beschriebenen Phonem-Eingabe.
2. Eingabe nach Phonem
Sie können die Laute, die Sie ausgesprochen haben
möchten, direkt zuweisen, indem Sie sie mit den
VOCALOID-Phonemsymbolen eingeben. Phonemsymbole
werden durch Vokale und Konsonanten in Klammern ([ ])
eingegeben, die für eine Silbe stehen.
Jede Klammereinheit ([ ]) muss immer einen Vokal
enthalten. Außerdem muss jedes Phonemsymbol durch
einen Leerschritt getrennt werden. Bei Einheiten, die
unaussprechliche Phonemsymbole enthalten, werden
keine Laute ausgegeben.
Wenn bei der Eingabe von Texten die Anzahl der
Textsilben nicht der Anzahl der Laute pro Takt
entspricht, werden die Laute nicht so zugewiesen, wie
sie bei der Beschreibung eingegeben wurden.

text: Consulta le istruzioni di AIUTO per la modifica del testo e i dialoghi VOCALOID.
Modifica con l'inserimento normale di lettere.
Per inserire testo e dialoghi per la pronuncia sono

rec: disponibili i seguenti due metodi.
1. Inserimento tramite parola in inglese
Inserendo le parole in inglese con uno spazio tra loro,
il server di conversione interpreterà ogni parola con
la pronuncia corretta. Dopo l'interpretazione, una
sillaba sarà assegnata a un suono.
Inoltre, se una parola è separata da uno o più trattini,
le porzioni della parola separate da uno o più trattini
saranno interpretate come una sola sillaba a cui
sarà assegnata un solo suono. Nota: Potrebbero
verificarsi dei problemi nell'interpretazione automatica
di parole insolite o poco usate. In caso di parole non
in inglese o non interpretabili, si consiglia di provare
a usare l'inserimento fonetico descritto qui di seguito.
2. Inserimento tramite fonema
Puoi assegnare direttamente dei suoni che vuoi far
pronunciare inserendoli con i simboli fonetici
VOCALOID. I simboli fonetici sono espressi da vocali
e consonanti tra parentesi quadre ([ ]) che
rappresentano una sillaba.
In ogni set di parentesi ([ ]) deve essere sempre
presente una vocale. Inoltre ogni simbolo fonetico
deve essere separato da uno spazio. Ogni parte che
contiene un simbolo fonetico non pronunciabile
risulterà priva di alcun suono.
Inserendo il testo, se il numero di sillabe create per il
testo non corrisponde al numero di suoni in ogni barra
della composizione, i suoni non saranno assegnati
come indicato nella descrizione.

Puedes utilizar los siguientes métodos para introducir la

rec: pronunciación de letras y diálogos.
1. Escritura por palabra inglesa
Si escribes palabras inglesas separadas por un espacio,
el servidor de conversión interpretará la pronunciación
correcta de cada una. Según esa interpretación, se
asignará un sonido a cada sílaba.
Además, si separaras con guiones fragmentos de una
palabra, cada uno de ellos se interpretará como una
sílaba y se le asignará un sonido diferente. Nota: puede
haber dificultades para interpretar automáticamente
palabras poco comunes. Si utilizas palabras en idiomas
diferentes al inglés o palabras de difícil interpretación,
usa el sistema de escritura por fonemas.
2. Escritura por fonemas
Puedes asignar directamente los sonidos que quieres oír
utilizando los símbolos fonéticos de VOCALOID. Los
símbolos fonéticos se expresan con vocales y
consonantes entre corchetes ([ ]) que representan una
sílaba.
En cada par de corchetes ([ ]) debe haber siempre una
vocal. Además, los símbolos fonéticos deben estar
separados por espacios. Si hay un fonema no
pronunciable, no se emitirá ningún sonido.
Al escribir la letra de una canción, si el número de
sílabas no se corresponde con el número de sonidos de
la composición, no se asignará ningún sonido.

text: 平和を愛するコスタリカの少女。

平和憲法を学ぶ、ガルベスの教え子。
コスタリカ各地に展開を始めた謎の武装勢力に囚われていた。
ガルベスと共に武装勢力の排除を“国境なき軍隊”に依頼する。
パスという名は、スペイン語で“平和”を意味する。

text: かつてNASAの研究員として将来を有望視されていたが、

rec: ある時よりDARPA（米国防高等研究企画局）に移り、
人工知能の研究に没頭するようになる。
人間嫌いで、滅多に人前に姿を現さない。

text: フランス人の鳥類学者。

rec: 中米の鳥類分布調査のためにコスタリカを訪れるが、
謎の遺跡に迷い込んでしまい、何者かに捕らえられる。

text: サンディニスタ民族解放戦線（FSLN）の司令官の娘として、

rec: ニカラグアにて革命を目的としたゲリラ活動を行う。
弾圧を逃れてコスタリカにたどり着くが、
謎の武装勢力により父を殺され、
新たなリーダーとして組織を率いていく使命を帯びる。

text: パス・オルテガ・アンドラーデ
ヴラジーミル・アレクサンドロヴィチ・ザドルノフ
セシール・コジマ・カミナンデス
アマンダ・バレンシアノ・リブレ
My name is Paz, and I'll do anything to protect my namesake.
70% of my existence is made of movies.

rec: It is up to you to decide what to do with the remaining 30%.

text: My father worked on the Manhattan Project.

rec: In a lifetime of research, he produced two things. The illusion of peace through deterrence...
And me and my useless legs.
One way or the other, I had to face up to the nukes.

text: Give me any order you want. I'll make it happen.
I left my hometown and haven't looked back.
I'm good to go as long as I have three square meals.
I'm going to be taking a good look at your command style.
Male, female... I heard it doesn't matter out here. I heard you'll use us just the same.
What's your sidearm of choice? A handgun? Or, maybe a submachine gun?
I'll go berserk if my pay's late.
Just so you know, I'm only here to pay for my kid brother's education, so spare me the cheesy battlefield romance.
I caught a whiff of an ocean breeze...
I won't disappoint you, and that's a promise.
Can't say I'm impressed by anyone here. I guess I'll have to help you out.
I used to work in a kitchen. Whether it's guns or knives, just leave it to me.
Let's square off in the ring next chance we have!
You do have a good medic, don't you? I mean, people die all the time from minor wounds that get infected. You gotta have a good medic.
My mom was a fighter pilot.
I don't choose sides. Whoever needs me, that's where I go.
I'm prepared to die for you!
I like that look you have in your eyes, Boss!
I majored in quantum mechanics, and I'm continuing my studies on the side.
The sky's so blue again today.
Did you know that 65% of the world's top assassins are women?
I may not look it, but I took third in a national weightlifting tournament.
I have a proven track record. No matter the mission, I'll deliver the goods.
Today is your lucky day. I'm going to join your unit!
My mother's in the hospital, so send me somewhere the pay's good. I don't care how dangerous it is.
Our rations include tea and scones, right?
So you're that Boss I heard about. It's an honor to meet you.
I smelled gallo pinto earlier. Is that what's for dinner?
I heard you train with unlimited live fire. That true?
If you're out of rations, why not have a snack instead? Like curry - mmm, can't get enough!
The more you use a certain weapon, the more of its natural power will be unleashed. Interesting... I'll have to remember that.
I don't like my hair to get messed up, but for you, I'll go fight.
Getting the highest clear rank means not killing, not being seen, and moving quickly. You can do it, Boss!
There's more than one way to "neutralize" somebody, right, Boss? You can knock 'em out with a stun rod, or put 'em to sleep with a tranq gun, or sneak up from behind and hold 'em up...
If it's taking too long to aim, switch to AUTO AIM. That's what's kept me alive all this time.
The "3 Slot" weapon select takes some getting used to, but once you get the hang of it, it's a cinch. And boy, is it deadly!
There's nothing like sleep for recovering LIFE! And if you can't sleep, lie down and stay still! Isn't that right, sir?
The more you use a weapon, the more of a feel you get for it. Eventually, it gets so it's almost a part of your body...
Sometimes a single word to your comrades can change the course of a battle... Wow, Boss, you always see things the rest of us don't.
You're never too busy to attend a briefing! See, Boss? I got it memorized!
Sir, I like the M16A1 for its low recoil. What's your favorite weapon, Boss?
You ever sneak up behind an enemy and ZAP 'em with the stun rod? Gives me the shivers every time!
Life is all about experience! Come to think of it, I guess that goes for drills, too... ugghh, I hate drills...
Do you believe in fate? Right now, I think I could.
I believe in you, Boss. Under your command, gender means nothing.
I just don't know what I'm good at... Can you tell what my skills are, Boss?
Staring at me's not going to do anything. Penny for your thoughts, sir.
I usually hate doing things for other people. But for you, Boss, I'll do anything.
I always saw myself as a lone wolf. But I guess people's values can change pretty quick. Lord knows I've changed since I came here.
I'm not the type to follow orders. Unless you're giving them, Boss.
I'm burning for some action! Got a mission for me?
I like it here. It's a nice place.
Do you believe in horoscopes? Me, I only believe in you.
What do you see in those eyes of yours...? Sorry, didn't mean to get personal.
When things get tough, think of me. That might ease the pain a little.
I can be kind of stubborn, but I'm a survivor, too.
People say I'm a little CRRRRRAZY...
I heard you're scared of vampires - is that true? Aww... that's actually kind of cute, Boss!
Don't underestimate me because I'm a woman. We ladies can fight in ways you men can't!
Give me a mission, and I'll do everything I can to get it done!
Boss! Send me out into the field! I'm going crazy just sitting around here! My legs are starting to cramp up!
Boss! Send me into the field! I promise I'll come back alive!
Comrade-in-stealth... it's got a nice ring to it.
You know, Commander Miller is actually kind of cute when he takes off those sunglasses.
I'm your man! Give me an order, I'll get it done!
I am hyped!! Let's do this!!!
I left some of my buddies behind on the last battlefield...

rec: You gonna give me the chance to make it up to them here?

text: I got a daughter. She's going to be 12 next year. I have to make it out of this alive!
I used to be a sailor. Best pair of eyes on the seas!

rec: Need someone who can see things a mile off?
You say weapons kill people?  I say they're needed to protect people.

text: I'm a martial arts expert - I know Combat Sambo and I'm a fifth degree black belt in karate!

rec: CQC? This I gotta see!

text: My grandpa was a mechanic. I can take an air-cooled engine apart in five minutes flat!
I got back from Vietnam and found I had no place to call home anymore...

rec: Mind if I stick with you guys for a while?

text: I went through hell in 'Nam... I'm ready for anything!
I was an Officer Candidate. Not much combat experience, but I speak seven languages.

rec: There's got to be some use for me here.
Back in my dad's day, every army battalion had its own dentist.

text: Costa Rica is full of swamps... make sure we got a good supply of dry socks.

rec: The last thing we need are fungal infections.

text: You're good. Better than I expected.
As much as I hate to say it, it's war that gives us our greatest breakthroughs in science and technology.
I know it takes more than weapons to make us strong and all, but at least give us some decent gear, alright?
Heh... Imagine. If only we had a guy like you running the country...

rec: Maybe my village wouldn't have been burned to the ground.

text: You look like you'll come in handy. I guess I'll stick around and help you out.
Gotta get your hands dirty to win a war...

rec: You know what I'm talking about, right?

text: We can do better than this.
You? A sneaking master?! Are you kidding me?

rec: I can smell the gunpowder on you a mile away!

text: I can smell it... The smell of blood...  Lots of blood...
Well, I've earned MY check... Time for a nap...
Guns kill people? Bro, sometimes guns are the only things that save lives.
I used to be a world-class gymnast, you know.

rec: 'Course, when it comes to a war, pride and glory don't mean a hell of a lot.

text: When this fight's over, I'm gonna go back home and find myself a wife...
I still haven't made up my mind about you yet.
I can tell that you're not in this 'cause you like the smell of hot lead. Am I right?
Just so you know, the more praise I get, the better I do.
Think you can take advantage of my skills?
Let's see, my horoscope says today's going to be... OK, I guess.
C'mon, give me a mission! My rifle's getting all rusty!
Things are never better than when they're ordinary.
I... I don't wanna fight. I wanna be a cook.
Hey Boss, at dinner do you eat your favorite food first, or save it for last?
You're like a knife out of its sheath, you know that?
(I'm too shy to talk to people... I believe in you, Boss...)
We're gonna make a name for ourselves!
Look, Boss! I caught a male Elephant Beetle, the world's heaviest insect!
Happy to be on board with you, Boss.
It's good to have comrades...especially on the battlefield.
Don't worry, I got your back!
Boss, if there's anything I can do to help make our technology better, I'll do it.
You want to know how to raise morale around here?

rec: Simple! Give us letters from our folks. And hot meals - can't fight on an empty stomach!

text: It's a real honor fighting with you...
Sometimes, I get to thinking. What is human life in the face of truly great scientific research?
Welcome back! I made something new for dinner today - want to try some?
I'm former SAS... what you think I'm B.S.-ing you?
I'm proud to be counted as one of your comrades, Boss!
I...I can't believe I'm actually meeting you in person, Boss!
(Just between you and me, I'm the guy who keeps MSF together...)
You stay here. I'll have this next mission wrapped up in no time.
This mission's nothing. I could do it with my eyes closed.
Boss, I've been meaning to tell you... nah, forget it. It's nothing.
I owe you one. Guess I better come with you.
Who'd have thought being stealthy could be such a thrill...
I actually kind of like the way you fight.
I'll show you how to get it done the smart way!

rec: That's the kind of guy I am!

text: Back home, I'm a pretty well-known journalist.

rec: I'm going to write your story and tell everybody how you lived.

text: You look prettier every time I see you.
Wish I could have met you sooner...
Listen, I never actually hated you...
It's all about the food. Give most guys a good meal and they won't complain.
When this battle's over, I'm going to get my life together...
Don't worry, my cooking's 100% safe for human consumption.
I've...never been in a real fight before...
If we met under different circumstances, I bet we could have been good friends.
Eureka! My research is going to blow your mind, Boss!
I just finished an incredible story! Could you read it and let me know what you think?
Before I became a mercenary, I was a doctor. Would you like to try this new drug I'm working on?
Quitting smoking is easy! Why, I've quit 20 times myself.
I can't promise you I won't do bad things, but

rec: I will promise you this: I'll never make us look bad.

text: Well now, looks like my boys gave you some trouble. Sorry 'bout that.

rec: I'll make it up to you. Here, take this.

text: Let's use our heads on this one.
Everybody can do something, but nobody can do everything.

rec: We'll do the things you can't.
And we need you to do the things we can't!

text: Ah, Boss, glad you're here. We were short one guy tonight.

rec: Care to join us for a little game?

text: You want me to forget last night...? Too late. It's all in my diary now.

rec: We won't let anybody take our hope from us!
I may not be strong, but I'll fight till the end!

text: What the hell, let's have fun out there!
When we're all done here, I think I'm going to start my own business.
Kill 'em, let 'em live... it's up to you. Either way, give 'em hell!!

rec: That's right. That's ...the way it should be, in a war.

text: Sometimes it's good to grab life by the horns.
Looks like another late night at the office...
You're number one, Boss. That makes me number two, right?
198, 199, 200! Oh, hey, Boss, you're just in time!

rec: I just finished doing 200 stomach crunches!

text: For the last time, stop treating me like a rookie!
I could learn to like this outfit.
Nothing feeds a developer like the sound of a satisfied user.
Why do it toda-a-ay? There's always tomorro-o-ow...
Ahhh, we got a nice big catch today!

rec: Tonight's dinner is gonna be fresh sashimi with cold Japanese sake.

text: I love to grill things. My favorite food is stir-fried noodles.

rec: Those grilled chicken skewers they got in Japan are pretty good, too.

text: I'm saving up all the money I make here, so when I get back to the States, I can go to college...
No need for you to go, Boss... I got this one covered.
We're not blood related, but we're still family.

rec: Come back home alive brother.

text: This place can only hold so many bodies. So make sure you bring back the best you can find. At least as good as me.
A lot of the most talented soldiers out there are in places where you can't recover them the usual way. I know there's gotta be some way to get them, but...
To get the higher-ranked weapons, you'll need to find the design specs and raise the level of the R&D Team. Guess you got your work cut out for you in the field and at Mother Base...
From what I've heard, supposedly there's a way to have items and ammo delivered right to you in the middle of a mission...
Back in my old unit, the commander used to tell us at morning calisthenics: "Whenever you're in trouble, hit the START button!!"

rec: Wonder how he's doing these days,

text: I-I saw some gigantic footprints in the swamp around El Cenagal...

rec: Y-you think it's a monstruo?

text: The other day, out of the blue we got a big box delivered to us.

rec: No return address, but it was full of all kinds of good stuff...
Kind of creepy, I know... but I wasn't about to complain!

text: For me, there's no greater thrill than seeing your exploits in PLAYER DATA, Boss!
With word about MSF going around, no wonder there are more volunteers who want to join.
I swear I saw fireworks last time I was in combat. Do they really make a weapon like that?
When I fire my weapon, I never aim for the head. Can't recruit 'em if they're dead, after all.
Some crates are too big to climb alone, but they're no problem if you got a buddy. Maybe that's what friendship is all about.
If you ever get stuck in a mission, retreating is always an option! Isn't that right?
Boss! The R&D Team is screwing around! They are playing with the cardboard boxes! What the hell is that?!
In combat, running out of ammo is a death sentence. Steal some from the enemy if you have to, or call for resupply, or search around the area! Good luck!
You can't attack while reloading. So find someplace to take cover when you do! That's what's kept me alive all these years.
Enemy hiding out of sight? Try the night-vision goggles. That's what I do.
Suppressors don't last forever. Use them enough and they wear out. Best to keep an eye on how long they've got left.
Whoa, almost screwed up back there... All because I didn't read the intel in the BRIEFING FILES first... You gotta use your brains, not just your brawn.
They say when you CO-OPS with somebody, you can tell who they regard as the greatest hero they've gone CO-OPS with.
I always go into a mission empty-handed. I can always borrow gear from my teammates.
Flying enemies are weak against explosions. Damage 'em with a missile and it might create an opening... right, Boss?
The canopies on attack choppers are pretty solid, but you can break though them. It's the only way to get at the pilot inside... But you probably already knew that.
A helicopter uses its tail rotor to combat counter-torque. In other words, without it the chopper can't fly straight. You could say it's like the chopper's jugular vein.
My instructor told me when you get up close and personal with the enemy, CQC works better than a rifle! I'm gonna practice every chance I get!
It's tough to see where you're going in the Ruinas de Xochiquetzal in Central Heredia. I wouldn't trust my eyes too much if I were you...

The last war I was in, I attached an extra weapon to the barrel of my assault rifle. It's kind of tricky to switch between them, but once you get used to it you'll wonder how you ever got on without it.
Sneak up behind the enemy and hold 'em up, then make sure you Fulton recover 'em! ...That's how I do it.

rec: Leave 'em with their hands up for too long and you never know when they're gonna turn their guns on you again.

text: Night-vision goggles aren't just useful at night. Foggy jungle, enemy smoke grenade - they come in handy anytime you can't see more than a few feet in front of you.
If only we had a weapon that let us capture those enemy heavy weapons without hurting them... maybe we could take them back to Mother Base and put them to use...
Yup... MSF needs all the firepower it can get. Like mechs, for example. Capturing them from the enemy would be quickest. Or, there's the other way...
There's two basic ways to take on a unit with a mech. Overwhelm them with sheer firepower, or take out the soldiers first and then capture the machine. Decisions, decisions...
You're not gonna believe this, but... I saw this cat-thing rowing a little boat down by the Caribbean coast! Next time you're on a mission down there, see if you can find it!
I love UMAs. Monsters, too... you know anybody who knows a lot about rare creatures? I want to pick their brain! Pick it CLEAN!
I don't care how good they taste, I HATE eating cold rations! If only we could grill 'em up a little... Then I'd be happy.
Flying weapons are usually pretty noisy. They ought to be easy to find if you've got a Surround Indicator... right, Boss?
They say there are monsters out there somewhere in this country, and if you hunt one down, you can use it to develop amazing gear. Of course, I don't believe a word of it.
The fuel tanks on the enemy's heavy weapons are painted red. Seems like that'd be a good place to shoot them.
Boss, did you know there's some kind of miracle gun that makes the sky do your bidding? Think we could make one here?
Missile-type weapons are heavy and have low ammo capacity. But they pack the most firepower of any portable weapon. Exactly what you need against heavy weapons.
Machine guns are powerful and carry a lot of ammo, so they're perfect for taking down mechs. Of course, they're also heavy and tough to handle...
Sniper rifles are the best for precision long-range shots. A lot of them even fire armor-piercing rounds.
Submachine guns are easy to aim, and they've got good rapid fire! Plus you can use them with a shield. You just have to get used to the muzzle jump, that's all.
Did you hear? Somebody said they saw "God" inside a truck somewhere...
Assault rifles are all-around solid weapons in every respect. There's lots of custom parts for them, too, so it's worth doing some R&D...
Shotguns are AWESOME! They can blow away just about anything in one shot. Only problem is they got short range and low ammo.

Handguns have short range and low firepower, but they've got great accuracy at close range and high-caliber ammo that stops targets in their tracks. And if you know when and how to use them, you can conserve your rifle ammo... That's a quote from the Boss. I learned it by heart!
The two things you gotta remember for sniper rifles are "crouch" and "aim." I guess 'cause it makes your hands shake less!
If you're using a one-handed weapon, you can equip a shield at the same time. And when it's not on your arm, it'll protect your back... isn't that what you said, Boss?
Handguns are great for indoors and in tight spaces... 'cause they're easy to aim.
You're telling me armor-piercing rounds go through shields and helmets?! Man, talk about punch.
Large-caliber handguns are the best tool for stopping the enemy from acting. AND they let you use CQC at the same time. If you find yourself surrounded, try going with a handgun.
You ever hear of these "battle cries" that make amazing things happen sometimes when you say them? Crazy, huh?
You know what I like about working for you, Boss? You know how to complete a mission without hurting anybody, without them even knowing you're there.
I thought my gear felt a little heavy... Turns out my guns alone weighed 20 pounds! No wonder my PSYCHE decreased. Heavier isn't always better, I guess.

Back when I was a rookie, I used to spray my assault rifle all over the place and waste ammo... You gotta stay focused, aim, and be smart with your trigger finger, fire in small bursts. It's not how many shots you fire, it's how many hit the target. I wish I'd realized that sooner...
Timing is everything in consecutive CQC, y'know. Gotta be cool, press the button at just the right time...
Boss, if you find me lying face down on the battlefield you gotta revive me! Uh, but no mouth-to-mouth, please!
In training I got CQC-thrown against a wall and got knocked out. Felt like it hurt at least twice as bad as a usual throw, too...
I bet even the toughest missions wouldn't be so bad for a two-man cell!  I'm gonna go look for somebody to team up and fight with!
Hey Boss, can you teach me how to reload?

rec: ...Ahh, so that's it! Just push the Action Button with the weapon equipped! Thanks a bunch, Boss!

text: Reloading leaves you temporarily vulnerable. Timing your reloads is just as crucial as timing your shots. Isn't it, Boss?
Hey Boss! Thanks for always listening to us grunts. I mean, even we can teach you something once in a while. Right?!
Chicks dig a man who smells like success!
Ahh, I get it... GMP is the sum total of MSF's income... the same way GNP expresses a country's total income...
If the next mission looks too tough for you, take a break and focus on recruiting or developing weapons... Yeah, that's right, never be in too big of a hurry!
In MISSION PREP we have to be careful not just about what gear we bring, but what uniform we wear. Right, Boss?
Check out the MAP to see where the exits are. Pretty handy if you ever get lost.
I think we could do a lot better job if we had stronger guns. We oughta get working on developing some new weapons!
I think we could do a lot better job if we had stronger guns. We oughta get working on developing some new weapons!
My great-grandpa used to tell me, "Sonny, bananas are good for more than just eatin'."
Boss, let me deploy on EXTRA OPS! I can handle it!
I've seen female soldiers being held prisoner. But I wasn't able to save them...
If a target's helmet is getting in the way, shoot it off with a bullet. It works best if you do it before they notice you. Right?
How fast a tranq dart works depends on where it hits... Ack, what the--? Unnhh... ZZZZ...
You gotta turn away as soon as you throw a stun grenade or you'll get stunned, too... Thanks for the tip, Boss!
One day, we'll have the science to turn a man invisible. And when that day comes... heh heh.
When you're using a sniper rifle, slow down, take a deep breath, and concentrate. It's true... you can actually feel your hands get steadier!
A man's got to eat to live. If you forget to bring food along on a mission, you better be damn good...
Man, I could go for a nice cold soda... That'd really hit the spot...
The Analyzer tells you how good a soldier is, so you can pick the best ones to recruit... That's the most logical way to go about it.
I like the M10... It's got a decent rate of fire and you can AUTO AIM it from a good distance.
My dream is to invent a weapon that lets you Fulton recover somebody from a distance...
So what if you get knocked out? A few good smacks and you'll wake right up!
Every mech has a weakness, no matter how big it is... And I intend to find it!
I heard there's a suit that makes your footsteps almost silent. Imagine how useful that'd be for sneaking up on people from behind.
You ever try running around lugging a big, heavy weapon? It ain't easy. Ain't fast, either...
With a high enough morale, a soldier can do things he never thought possible. Me, I'm ready to rock!
The golden rule of staff management is, let people do what they do best. So, where do you need me to go?
Comrades, lets keep communication tight!  What...? You can't find the right words!? Well then make sure you set your "CO-OPS COMM" in "MISSION PREP" so it doesn't happen again!
You know when you get a package, and it's exactly what you needed the most? I always get a little misty when that happens...
If I ever manage to get a girlfriend, I wanna take her inside a cardboard box... and spend some quality time together...
I wonder if you could use a cardboard box as a step to get up to places you couldn't usually reach by yourself...
I coulda sworn I saw a guy who looked just like me... Hm. Must have been a coincidence.
It's nice to have a place to come back home to. I'm glad I joined up with you.
The food ain't too bad here. 'Course, it's nothing like my ma's.
I got a wife and daughter back in my home country. Gotta work hard so they can eat.
Boss, MSF is more than just you. Don't forget that.
I'm saving up my pay to buy a house and get married!
Man... I'm sick of people treating me like a rookie! Ugh...
You wanna know what's the most powerful weapon known to man? A good poker face.
Need some luck? Stick with me and maybe some of mine will rub off.
This place is full of morons... That's why I love it so much.
Call me... ah, forget it. Call me whatever you want.
Check out this tattoo. Each one of these stars stands for a battlefield I've slogged through... they're actually just stickers, but still...
Support is just as crucial as combat! Anything you need, let me know!
I need a mission that REALLY gets me motivated...
The bacon in the mess hall was extra crispy this morning. I feel like I can do anything today.
Boss! That magazine I lent you before the last mission. Can I have it--what?! You left it out there?! I hadn't finished reading it!!
Give me an order, Boss. I'm not what you'd call a self-starter.
I got two yolks in my egg this morning. So I'm gonna work twice as hard today! ...Or at least complain half as much!
Boss! Send me into battle! I can handle it!
I can never seem to balance work and pleasure. 'Cause whatever I'm working on turns into pleasure.
Hey Boss, let's get as many new guys as we can and make MSF into something REAL big!
We got skills, too, Boss! Take a look and see!
When's the party gonna start, amigo?
Wish I could see the Loch Ness Monster or Quetzalcoatl once in my life...
Boss! He says there's no Santa Claus! Santa's real, isn't he?!
Boss! He says Santa Claus is real! There's no such thing as Santa, is there?!
I may not look it, but I'm turning 48 this year.
I'll be honest. I don't think I'm good enough. But I want to be. And I'm training hard.
Give yourself a little break once in a while, Boss.
Everything about this place is hot, hot. The weather, the work...
I'm a mountain boy. All this water, and boats and stuff... erk. Give me a mission, quick...
It's an honor to serve under a hero like you.
I can't sleep at night unless I clean my gun once a day. I'm itching for an overhaul...
Thanks for the Costa Rican coffee. Best I ever tasted.
My wife was always good to me. Guess that's what "love" is.
If I die, we'll meet again in the next life. As comrades.
One thing I've realized since I got here - there's all kinds of people in this world.
Take a look at these guns. I was the arm wrestling champion of my hometown two years running. And runner-up the year before that, and champion the year before THAT.
Can we have curry on Friday? I love curry!
I used to be in the army, but the government sold us out. Is there anything worth risking your life for anymore?
You stay here too long, you start losing track of what day it is.
I like to CALL people on the radio while I'm on a mission. It's a good way to get useful info, and it reminds me I'm not alone out there.
I'm a slave to fashion. I collect T-shirts in my spare time.
It's important to know what to wear, even on the battlefield. The right clothes for the right occasion.

Pour obtenir le meilleur classement terminé, il faut ne pas tuer, ne pas être repéré et se déplacer vite. Tu peux y arriver, Boss !

Si viser prend trop de temps, passe en visée automatique. C’est comme ça que j’ai réussi à survivre aussi longtemps.
Le 3-slot demande un peu de temps pour s’y faire, mais une fois que tu es au point, c’est du gâteau. Et c’est dévastateur.
Pour récupérer de la Vie, rien de tel que le sommeil ! Et si tu ne peux pas dormir, allonge-toi et reste immobile. N’ai-je pas raison, Chef ?
Plus tu utilises une arme, plus tu la ressens bien. À la fin, elle devient comme une extension de ton corps.
Parfois, un mot à ses compagnons d’armes peut changer le cours d’une bataille. Ouah, Boss, tu vois toujours ce qui nous échappe.
On n’est jamais trop occupée pour rater un briefing ! Tu vois, Boss ! J’ai retenu la leçon !
Moi, j’aime bien le M16A1 pour son faible recul. C’est quoi ton arme préférée, Boss ?
Tu te faufiles derrière les ennemis et tu les zappes avec la matraque étourdissante ? Ça me donne des frissons à chaque fois !
La vie, c’est surtout l’expérience ! Maintenant que j’y pense, c’est pareil pour l’entraînement... Bah, je déteste ça.
Tu crois au destin ? Là, tout de suite, je crois que je pourrais y croire.
Je crois en toi, Boss. Tu es un chef qui traite femmes à égalité.
Je ne sais même pas à quoi je suis bonne ! Tu sais, toi, ce que je sais faire, Boss ?
Me fixer comme ça ne va te mener nulle part. Mets ton mouchoir là-dessus, Chef.
En général, je déteste aider les autres. Mais pour toi, Boss, je ferais n’importe quoi.
J'ai toujours eu l’impression d’être une louve solitaire. Mais il faut croire qu’on peut changer très vite. Dieu sait que j’ai changé depuis que je suis ici.
Je ne suis pas du genre à obéir. Sauf si c’est toi qui donnes les ordres, Boss.
Je veux de l’action ! Tu as une mission pour moi ?
Je me plais bien ici. C’est sympa.
Tu crois à l’astrologie ? Moi, il n’y a qu’en toi que je crois.
Qu’est-ce qu’on peut lire au fond de tes yeux ? Pardon, je ne voulais pas devenir trop intime.
Quand ça sera dur, pense à moi. Ça t’aidera peut-être un peu.
Je suis un peu têtue, mais je suis aussi résiliente.
On dit que je suis un peu fofolle...
Il paraît que tu as peur des vampires. C’est vrai ? Oh, comme c’est gentil, Boss !
Ne me sous-estime pas parce que je suis une fille. Nous, les femmes, on a des façons de se battre dont vous les hommes, vous ignorez tout !
Donne-moi une mission et je ferai tout ce qu'il faut pour réussir !
Boss ! Envoie-moi sur le terrain ! Je deviens folle à tourner en rond ici ! J’ai des fourmis dans les jambes.
Boss ! Envoie-moi sur le terrain ! Je te promets de revenir vivante !
Camarades de furtivité... ça sonne bien.
Tu sais, le commandant Miller est plutôt mignon quand il enlève ses lunettes de soleil.
Je suis à ton service ! Donne tes ordres et j'exécute !
J'ai laissé quelques-uns de mes compagnons sur le dernier champ de bataille…

rec: Tu vas me donner l'occasion de me rattraper ?

text: J'ai une fille. Elle va avoir 12 ans. Je dois m'en sortir vivant.
J'ai été marin. Les meilleurs yeux de l'océan ! Tu as besoin de quelqu'un qui voit à un kilomètre à la ronde ?

rec: Tu dis que les armes tuent les gens ? Je dis qu'elles servent à les protéger.

text: Je suis expert en arts martiaux. Je connais le Sambo et je suis ceinture noire cinquième dan de karaté.
Mon grand-père était mécanicien. Je peux démonter un moteur à refroidissement par air en 5 minutes !
Je suis rentré du Vietnam et je me suis rendu compte que je n'avais nulle part où aller…

rec: Ça vous dérange si je reste avec vous un moment les gars ?

text: J'ai traversé l'enfer du Vietnam… Je suis prêt à tout !
J'étais postulant au grade d'officier. Je n'ai pas une très grande expérience du combat, mais je parle sept langues.

rec: Je peux être utile ici.
À l'époque de mon père, chaque bataillon disposait d'un dentiste.

text: Le Costa Rica est plein de marécages… assure-toi d'avoir une réserve suffisante de chaussettes sèches.

rec: La dernière chose dont on a besoin, c'est d'une mycose.

text: Tu es bon. Meilleur que je ne le pensais.
Bien que cela me coûte de le dire, c'est la guerre qui nous a donné nos plus grandes avancées scientifiques et technologiques.
Je sais qu'il faut plus que des armes pour nous rendre forts, mais au moins, donne-nous un équipement décent, d'accord ?
Hé… Imagine. Si seulement nous avions eu un type comme toi au pays… Peut-être que mon village n'aurait pas été réduit en cendre.
Finalement, tu vas servir à quelque chose. Je crois que je vais rester dans le coin et te donner un coup de main.
Il faut se salir les mains pour gagner une guerre…

rec: Tu vois ce que je veux dire, n'est-ce pas ?

text: On peut faire mieux que ça.
Toi ? Un maître de l'infiltration ? Tu te fous de moi ?

rec: Tu sens la poudre à canon à un kilomètre à la ronde !

text: Je peux la sentir… L'odeur du sang… Beaucoup de sang...
Bon, j'ai gagné ma paie…  C'est le moment de faire la sieste…
Les armes tuent les gens ?  Parfois, seules les armes peuvent sauver les gens, frangin.
J'ai été un gymnaste de renommée mondiale, tu sais.

rec: Bien sûr, quand la guerre survient, la fierté et la gloire ne veulent plus dire grand-chose.

text: Quand le conflit sera terminé, je rentrerai chez moi et je me trouverai une femme.
Je ne me suis pas encore fait une idée précise de ta personne.
Je peux te dire que tu n'es pas ici pour l'odeur du plomb. Je me trompe ?
Pour ta gouverne, plus je reçois d'éloges, meilleur je suis.
On se prend un verre plus tard ? C'est moi qui régale.
Tu crois que tu peux tirer avantage de mes compétences ?
Voyons voir, mon horoscope dit que cette journée va être… bonne, je crois.
Allez, donne-moi une mission ! Mon fusil est en train de rouiller !
Il n'y a rien de meilleur que les choses simples.
Je… Je ne veux pas me battre. Je veux être cuisinier.
Hé Boss, à table, tu commences par ce que tu préfères ou tu le gardes en dernier ?
Tu es comme un couteau sorti de son fourreau, tu sais ça ?
Mes muscles ne me font jamais défaut.
(Je suis trop timide pour parler aux gens… Je crois en toi, Boss…)
On va se faire un nom !
Regarde Boss, j'ai attrapé un scarabée éléphant, l'insecte le plus lourd du monde !
Content d'être à bord avec toi, Boss.
C'est bon d'avoir des camarades… surtout sur le champ de bataille.
Ne t'inquiète pas, je te couvre !
Boss, si je peux faire quoi que ce soit pour améliorer notre technologie, je le ferai.
De la bonne nourriture chaque jour !
Tu veux savoir comment rehausser le moral ici ? C'est simple ! Donne-nous le courrier de nos familles, et des repas chauds. On ne combat pas l'estomac vide !
C'est un honneur de combattre à tes côtés…
Parfois, je me demande, qu'est-ce que la vie humaine face à la recherche scientifique de haut niveau ?
Bienvenue ! Aujourd'hui, j'ai fait quelque chose de nouveau pour le dîner. Tu veux goûter ?
Je suis un ancien SAS... Tu crois que c'est des salades ?
Je suis fier de faire partie de tes hommes, Boss !
Je… Je n'arrive pas à croire que je te rencontre en personne, Boss !
(Juste entre toi et moi, je suis celui qui fait en sorte de garder MSF soudé…)
Tu restes ici. Je vais exécuter la prochaine mission en un rien de temps.
Cette mission, c'est du gâteau. Je pourrai la faire les yeux fermés.
Boss, je voulais te dire… rien, laisse tomber. Aucune importance.
J'ai une dette envers toi. Je crois que je ferais mieux de t'accompagner.
Qui aurait pensé que l'infiltration pourrait être aussi excitante…
En fait, j'aime bien ta façon de te battre.
Je vais te montrer une façon intelligente de le faire. Voilà le genre de mec que je suis !
Chez moi, je suis un journaliste réputé.

rec: J'écrirai ton histoire et je raconterai à tout le monde ce que tu as fait.

text: Tu es de mieux en mieux à chaque fois que je te vois.
J'aurais aimé te rencontrer plus tôt…
Écoute, je ne t'ai jamais haï en réalité…
Tout passe par la nourriture. Donne plus de bonne nourriture aux hommes et ils ne se plaindront pas.
Quand ce conflit sera terminé, je vais m'occuper de moi...
Ne t'inquiète pas, ma cuisine est 100 % adaptée à la consommation humaine.
Je n'ai… Je n'ai jamais pris part à un vrai combat jusqu'ici...
Si nous nous étions rencontrés dans d'autres circonstances, je parie qu'on aurait pu être bons amis.
Eurêka !  Mes recherches vont t'en mettre plein la vue, Boss !
Je viens juste de terminer une histoire incroyable ! Pourrais-tu la lire et me dire ce que tu en penses ?
Avant de devenir un mercenaire, j'étais docteur. Veux-tu essayer ce nouveau médicament sur lequel je travaille ?
C’est facile d'arrêter de fumer ! J'ai moi-même arrêté vingt fois.
Je ne peux pas te promettre que je ne ferai rien de mal,

rec: mais je vais te promettre que  je ne ferai jamais en sorte
qu'on est l'air mauvais.

rec: J'en suis désolé. Pour me faire pardonner, tiens, prends ça.

text: Tout le monde peut faire quelque chose, mais personne ne peut tout faire. Nous ferons les choses que tu ne pourras pas faire. Et nous avons besoin de toi pour faire les choses que nous ne pouvons pas faire.
Ah, Boss, content de te voir. Il va nous manquer un gars ce soir.

rec: Tu veux te joindre à nous pour une petite partie ?

text: Tu veux que j'oublie la nuit dernière…? Trop tard. Tout est déjà dans mon journal.
Tu es notre plus grand espoir, Boss !

rec: Nous ne laisserons personne nous prendre cela !
Je ne suis peut-être pas fort, mais j'irai jusqu'au bout !

text: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a, allons nous amuser là-bas !
Quand on en aura fini ici, je crois que j'irai monter ma propre affaire.
Tue-les, laisse-les en vie… C'est à toi de voir. Quoi qu'il en soit, fais en sorte qu'ils en bavent !

Encore une longue nuit au bureau...

198, 199, 200 ! Oh, Boss, tu tombes à pic ! Je viens juste de terminer mes 200 abdos !
Pour la dernière fois, arrête de me traiter comme un bleu !
Je peux apprendre à aimer cette tenue.
Rien ne récompense mieux un développeur que le bruit que fait un utilisateur satisfait.
Pourquoi faire aujourd'hui… Ce qu'on peut faire demain…
Ah, on a eu une belle prise aujourd'hui !

rec: On aura du sashimi frais et du saké froid japonais pour le dîner de ce soir.

text: J'adore cuisiner. Mon plat favori, ce sont les nouilles chinoises sautées. Ces brochettes de poulet grillé qu'ils ont au Japon sont très bonnes elles aussi.
Je mets de côté tout l'argent que je gagne ici, comme ça, à mon retour aux États-Unis, je pourrais aller à l'université.
Pas la peine de te déranger, Boss… Quelqu'un s'en occupe.
Nous ne sommes pas liés par le sang, mais nous sommes quand même une famille. Reviens-nous vivant, mon frère.
Cet endroit peut contenir beaucoup de personnes. Alors, assure-toi de ramener les meilleurs. Au moins aussi bons que moi.
Beaucoup des meilleurs soldats là-bas sont dans des lieux où tu ne peux pas les récupérer de la manière habituelle. Je sais qu'il y a des moyens de les avoir, mais…
Pour obtenir les meilleures armes, tu devras trouver les spécifications techniques et augmenter le niveau de l'équipe R&D. Je crois que tu as du pain sur la planche dehors et à la Mother Base…
